question: Consider the pytest test `werkzeug_qa/converters_to_url_s5_exceptions/files/testcase.py::FloatToUrlTest::test_float_to_url_stream` (file `werkzeug_qa/converters_to_url_s5_exceptions/files/testcase.py`, class `FloatToUrlTest`, single test method `test_float_to_url_stream`). The message is exactly `str(exc)`, character for character (including any quotes, spaces and punctuation inside it; no surrounding quotes added, no type prefix, no stripping).
